content.what_it_is: Conditional Fortran SUBGRID_MODULE (L51-L449). SUBGRID_INITIAL (L76-L191) reads a main-to-subgrid ratio and bathymetry filenames, allocates main-grid porosity/average/max depth and four-dimensional subgrid depth arrays, reads main and subgrid bathymetry, derives maximum depth, wet-pixel fraction, and an average over all subpixels, replaces near-zero porosity by one for the downstream solver, and optionally writes porosity.ini. UPDATE_SUBGRID (L193-L228) recomputes average wet depth and porosity only where MaskSubgrid is one using Eta plus subgrid depth. GetFile_SubGrid has parallel (L230-L302) and serial (L303-L341) implementations: both parse sparse rows keyed by Ix,Iy with SubMainGridRatio squared values and fall back to main-grid Depth outside the sparse mask; the parallel branch reads global arrays on rank zero and repeatedly calls GLOB_to_LOC. GLOB_to_LOC (L345-L444) pads global edge ghosts on rank zero, gathers each rank's global interior bounds, then sends each ghost-extended rectangular slice with nonblocking point-to-point MPI.

unresolved: Use-before-assignment/default-path defect: SubMainGridRatio is declared without initialization at L62, READ_INTEGER is called at L89, and ierr==1 only emits 'use 1 for default' at L90-L100; no SubMainGridRatio=1 assignment occurs before NumPixel and allocation extents use it at L104-L109. Correctness depends on undocumented mutation by READ_INTEGER even on failure.

Range defect: no check enforces SubMainGridRatio>0 before NumPixel is formed at L104, dimensions are allocated at L106-L109, and division by REAL(NumPixel) occurs at L171-L172 and L213-L214. Zero or negative input can therefore create invalid/zero extents and division by zero.

Range defect: sparse-file Ix/Iy are used directly as PHIGLOB(Ix,Iy,...) at L257-L261 in the parallel path and as Ix+Nghost/Iy+Nghost at L330-L334 in the serial path, with no bounds validation against global or local array extents.

MPI cross-line size/rank assumption: gather destination arrays are allocated with nprocs entries at L396, but the send loop is bounded by px*py at L411 and indexes the gathered arrays with irank+1 at L413-L416. No local check establishes px*py==nprocs; a mismatch can overrun bounds or address nonexistent ranks.

Copy/paste defect: the file header says 'TIDE_MODULE ... add tide/surge boundary conditions' at L46, while the implemented entity is SUBGRID_MODULE at L52 and all procedures implement subgrid bathymetry/porosity.
